title: The Death of Jehoiada and Joash's Apostasy from the Lord
description: After the faithful priest Jehoiada died at the age of 130 and was buried among the kings, King Joash allowed himself to be persuaded by the leaders of Judah to abandon the house of the Lord and worship Asherah poles and idols. Then God's wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem, and the Lord sent prophets to bring the people back, but they would not listen.
